name: An Rialálaí Agraibhia (The Agri Food Regulator)
reason: Established body that foi.gov.ie's all-foi-bodies directory does not list (checked 2026-10-18). Restores it to the FOI-subject set alongside the directory-derived entries.

name: Comhlacht Formhaoirsithe Seachtrach Óglaigh na hÉireann (the External Oversight Body)
reason: Listed in the register and in inclusion sets predating the switch to the foi.gov.ie-derived set, but absent from foi.gov.ie's directory (checked 2026-10-18). Kept subject to FOI until the directory or a human reviewer says otherwise.

name: Fiosrú - Oifig an Ombudsman Póilíneachta.
reason: Present in inclusion sets before the switch to the foi.gov.ie-derived set, and the pipeline has crawled FOI pages and a disclosure log for it. Not on foi.gov.ie's directory (checked 2026-10-18), which is a source gap rather than a retirement.

name: Office of the Protected Disclosures Commissioner
reason: Unambiguously subject to FOI and publishes its own disclosure log, but foi.gov.ie's directory omits it (checked 2026-10-18). The directory is the primary source, not an exhaustive one.
